subject: environmental-science
title: Water in the Environment: Foundations
welcome_lead: Earth is the water planet — and most of it is salty.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: where water lives, fresh vs salt.
final_note: Most fresh water is locked in ice — clean water is precious.

concepts.def: Water with little salt — drinkable when clean.

walkthroughs.body_html: About 97% of Earth's water is salt water. Only 3% is fresh, and most of that is locked in glaciers and ice.
Fresh water is in glaciers, lakes, rivers and aquifers. We tap reservoirs and underground stores for taps and farms.
A catchment is land where rain drains into one river. Pollution at the top affects everything downstream.
